messages:
eva: Heads-up — I’m seeing a reproducible formatting regression on model-legal-3b after switching quant stacks (FP8->AWQ/INT8). Table outputs get cell-shifted, e.g., columns merge into previous cell. Happens on legalqa-table-v1.

kevin: Can you paste a minimal example and the outputs? :thinking:

eva: Sure, here's a sanitized prompt + outputs.

```
PROMPT: "Return a 3x3 table of statutes and sections with columns: statute, section, summary."

ORIGINAL (FP8 run):
| statute | section | summary |
| Stat A | §10 | Short desc A |
| Stat B | §21 | Short desc B |
| Stat C | §33 | Short desc C |

AWQ-INT8 output:
| statute | section | summary |
| Stat A | §10 | Short desc A |
| Stat B | §21Short desc B |
| Stat C | §33 | Short desc C |
```

kevin: Hmm that's a token boundary / delimiter loss. What eval metrics show?

sara-ml: Ran batch eval on legalqa-table-v1 across quant stacks this morning:
- FP8 (baseline): EM 81.2, F1 88.4
- GPTQ: EM 79.9, F1 87.1
- AWQ-int8: EM 74.5, F1 82.6  <-- big drop, formatting precision down 12% on tables
- INT8-old: EM 77.3, F1 84.0

jonathan: Is this correlated with sequence length or batch size? Could be KV-cache offset.

eva: I checked. Failures spike when prompts induce multi-line table output (seq len > 512) and when batching >1 on the same worker. Per-request (batch=1) AWQ-int8 looks much better.

quant-bot: new test run queued: quant-bisect --model model-legal-3b --dataset legalqa-table-v1 --variants FP8,GPTQ,AWQ --seed 42 --batch-sizes 1,4,8

kevin: Possible causes:
- AWQ blocksize/padding handling concatenates tokens across delimiter boundaries
- batch-ordering + shared KV buffer bug in the runtime for AWQ kernels
- calibration set too small for tables -> underflow on certain tokens

sara-ml: Quick repro: run
```
python repro_table_issue.py --model model-legal-3b --quant awq --batch 4 --seed 2025
```
I get cell joins ~7% of cases.

eva: Also noticed that dedicated infra (reserved-gpu-v2) with isolated workers doesn't show the batch>1 spike. Hosted shared pools do. So routing/deployment profile matters.

jonathan: Action items:
1) kevin: run bisect to narrow kernel commit range and try AWQ with blocksize=64.
2) sara-ml: run larger calibration (10k table samples) and re-eval.
3) eva: collect 25 failing examples and put them in /shared/quant/bugs/1768009456_cases.
4) infra: confirm if worker reuse settings differ between hosted and dedicated.

kevin: started a bisect on commit range 3f2a..f9d1, swapping AWQ blocksize param now.

quant-bot: bisect progress: failing commit identified at f1d3c (AWQ kernel change: padding optimization)

kevin: repro locally by reverting that change — tables fixed. suspect padding optimizer skipped delimiter handling.

sara-ml: After recalibration (10k) + blocksize=64 AWQ: EM 78.8, F1 86.9 — still slightly below FP8 but acceptable for some deployments.

eva: For now: pin model-legal-3b -> FP8 on hosted until AWQ patch lands; on Dedicated we can keep AWQ with blocksize=64 (ops okay with slightly lower perf).

jonathan: I'll open a changelist for AWQ kernel to restore delimiter-aware padding and add unit tests for multi-line structured outputs.

kevin: assigning to @kevin and @infra to coordinate patch + rollout. I'll push a canary with the revert to a small traffic slice.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy created: model-legal-3b-awq-patch-canary -> 5% traffic -> region us-west1

eva: thanks — saving failing examples and will follow up when canary results in 2h. :eyes:

kevin: note — this is a reminder that quant stack swaps need structured-output smoke tests (tables/csv/json) in CI.

sara-ml: Agreed. Creating a small suite: structured-output-smoke / legalqa-table-v1 subset.

eva: tagging folks: @sara-ml @kevin @jonathan -- will share final eval numbers once canary finishes.
